'''2012 Worlds Day 2 Jerome Nitschke DS Hunt Down And Destroy''' was the Dark Side constructed list played by [[Jerome Nitschke]] at [[2012 World Championship]] (Day 2).

* '''Event:''' [[2012 World Championship]]

* '''Stage:''' Day 2
